dialogs.text: You're just in time, Traveler! I was just looking for you!
Eh? What's up, Little Meng?
Do you remember when I asked you to help me send a drifting bottle downriver with my worries in it?
I honestly wasn't holding out much hope...
But then, one of my father's business partners came looking for him a few days ago.
He said that they're currently looking to get into the mushroom business, and are planning to go to Sumeru to survey the market.
So they wanted to ask my dad if he wanted to go with them.
They even said that they could take me along!
Dad didn't agree at first, but one of his friends pulled out a letter and asked to speak privately with him.
They talked for a while, and after that, Dad said that I could go with him to Sumeru...
Well, I don't know why he changed his mind so suddenly, but...
I can go to Sumeru now! We're going to Sumeru! Woohoo!
Congratulations!
It must be that drifting bottle we sent, I just know it! Thank you so much, Traveler!
Dad said that after going to Sumeru, they'll also go to a place called Qiaoying Village.
Qiaoying Village?
Yup. Dad says it's a tea village where they plant lots of tea trees that produce super high-quality tea leaves. The name's a bit of a toughie, though...
Well, but let's put that aside for now. We'll need to get to Sumeru first.
It's really far from here, so it's going to take a while for us to get there.
But I've heard people say that traveling requires a lot of preparations, since you could encounter all kinds of situations on the way.
You're a frequent traveler, so... could you teach me a few tricks for life on the road?
Like, uh...
Like, what do you usually eat when you're out traveling?
Dad says that they would always eat stuff they made themselves. But I only know a few simple dishes, and I don't know if I can do them well or not...
#Ohohoho! Cooking! Now that's something we're experts at, huh, {NICKNAME}?
That's right. I can teach you.
Well, then Paimon thinks we should go look for a stove-top somewhere...
...Hmm, why don't we borrow Chef Mao's kitchen?
Chef Mao? Uhh... Isn't he pretty scary most of the time?
Chef Mao? Scary? He's a great guy!
R—Really? But every time Dad and I eat there, he'd scrunch up his eyebrows whenever I'd pick the Qingxin out of my dish and not eat it...
That's right. Leave it to me!
Y'know, I might be going to Sumeru myself.
Really? Then let's meet there!

flow.stepDescription: Teach Little Meng how to cook

dialogs.text: Oh, if it isn't the Traveler and Little Meng! Do you need anything?
Eh? I, uh, um... Traveler...
We'd like to borrow your kitchen, please.
Sure, but that's a little sudden of you...
Oh. Is that how it is... Alright, use it as you please.
Little Meng, remember not to be picky with your food while you're out traveling.
I—I got it...
Traveler, please teach me how to make something really tasty.
I'd like to give Dad a surprise while we're on the road.
You got it!
#Now then, {NICKNAME}, what shall we make?

dialogs.text: Have you found our new ingredient, Traveler?
That should be all. Alright then, Traveler, I'm ready to receive your instruction.
Aaaand that's a wrap!
Uh-oh. Where did we go wrong?
Did we put too much Slime Condensate in?
This dish looks pretty good. You've got talent, Little Meng!
Chicken-Mushroom Skewer.
Ooh, that's an adventurer classic!
Satisfying Salad.
Mm-hmm. Simple and good.
Sweet Madame.
Hehe, delicious! But Paimon wonders if it might be too difficult...
Wow, this recipe is so detailed... So many words...
Hmm. You know what? Paimon gets the feeling that it won't quite be a pleasant surprise if it's this simple.
Eh? Then what should we do?
Why don't we... add some unique ingredients into the mix?
What should we add, though?
Jueyun Chilis.
Gonna put the spice into culinary life, eh? Sounds great!
Long-distance travel tires people out, so a little spice can help keep people alert.
Alright then! Let's go find ourselves some Jueyun Chilis!
Sweet Flowers.
Gonna make this dish just a little sweeter, huh?
Sweet foods really do lift one's spirits.
Let's go find ourselves a few Sweet Flowers.
Slime Condensate!
Aw yeah! Paimon's favorite!
Uh, can Slime Condensate really be used to make meals?
Oooof course they can! We even know a master chef who uses Slime Condensate in her cooking!
Woohoo! Time to go look for some Slime Condensate!
Hehehe... Paimon's looking forward to this one!
I'm counting on you, Traveler. I need to read this recipe carefully...
Wow, there's... so many words... Uh, how do I read this one again?
In conclusion, it's all about getting the basics down — everything after that is practice, practice, practice!
Yup! I'll practice hard for sure! Thank you, Traveler!
Sumeru... Hehe, I can't wait!
